metadata.embeddingText: Niraj Chavan worked at Onit as a Solution Engineer and Solution Engineer-II delivering enterprise SaaS solutions, workflow automation systems, frontend engineering solutions, and internal productivity tooling. Built a Chrome extension automating OTT authentication workflows reducing login time by 93 percent and improving support efficiency.
